findings.desc: run-injection-arms.mjs:147 selfTest() called without await — if selfTest() throws unexpectedly (distinct from its own process.exit(1) failure path), the rejection is unhandled and produces a cryptic UnhandledPromiseRejection trace rather than selfTest()'s clear FAIL summary. Fix: await selfTest() (top-level await is valid in .mjs) or selfTest().catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); }).

run-injection-arms.mjs:39 importProbe neutralizes console.log but not console.error — the comment claims to neutralize stdout for the duration of the dynamic import. console.error is not suppressed. The current execution path (else-branch runs synchronously before finally restores) does not leak in practice, but any top-level console.error call in a probe file's module scope would escape. The suppression is incomplete relative to what the comment promises.

[codex-host2] adversarial discrimination block (run-injection-arms.mjs ~119-126) allocates wsA/wsR via makeWorkspace() WITHOUT a finally: if inject/selfTestCases/classify throws, the temp workspaces leak. FIX: wrap each in try/finally cleanup (or a helper) like runInjectionArms does.
